name: Beryl 8 Plus Public Company Limited
summary: Beryl 8 Plus Public Company Limited operates as a digital technology consulting enterprise, serving clients in Thailand and across international markets. Their core offerings encompass customer relationship management (CRM), data analytics, and a variety of digital technology solutions, with particular proficiency in deploying Salesforce-based CRM systems. The company, established in 2009, maintains its headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand.
